title: VWP Signature
description: Experimental in v0.1. A detached signature record over the package manifest (which in turn declares part hashes). v0.1 verifiers may treat signatures as informational.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm identifier, e.g. a JWS 'alg' value such as ES256, or 'placeholder' in v0.1 demos.

scope.description: What was signed. v0.1 signatures sign 'manifest.json'.

value.description: The signature value (e.g. compact JWS or base64), or a placeholder string in v0.1 demos.
